name: tieba-image-downloader
description: Download original images from Baidu Tieba posts through a reusable agent skill.

interface.shortDescription: Download original images from a Tieba post.
interface.longDescription: Give the agent a Baidu Tieba post URL. The skill installs the verified release binary when needed, runs the resumable downloader, and reports the output without manual CLI or cookie extraction.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $download-tieba-images to download the original images from the Baidu Tieba post URL I provide and report the result.
